author: KEXP
description: Los Angeles band DECEITS inject new life into post-punk with their own colors rhythms, and emotional intensity. Live on KEXP with host DJ Sharlese, the band share a performance of "One Day You’ll Hurt As Much As Me" and more.
title: DECEITS perform "One Day You’ll Hurt As Much As Me" & more Live on KEXP
